newsitem.title: USA: Santa Anita calls offer incomplete. [CORRECTED 00:04 GMT 29/10]
newsitem.headline: Santa Anita calls offer incomplete. [CORRECTED 00:04 GMT 29/10]

text.p: The Santa Anita Cos said it believes that Apollo/Koll's proposal is incomplete.

If Apollo/Koll has a bona fide proposal to make to the Santa Anita Companies, then it will be able to supply the type of substantive information referred to in our letter. According to a Securities and Exchange Commission filing, Apollo Real Estate Advisors and The Koll Co hold 808,000 paired shares of the Santa Anita companies, purchased for $15.6 million (corrects to clarify which company would supply information).
The shares represent a stake of 7.10 percent in Santa Anita Realty and 7.17 percent in Santa Anita Operating, the filing showed. The two companies are traded as paired shares.
